# cycle_servers (Data Source)

Lists Cycle servers in the hub, optionally filtered to a single cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every server in the hub.
data "cycle_servers" "all" {}

# Or only those in a specific cluster.
data "cycle_servers" "production" {
  cluster = "production"
}

output "live_server_hostnames" {
  value = [
    for srv in data.cycle_servers.production.servers : srv.hostname
    if srv.state == "live"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cluster` (String) When set, only servers belonging to this cluster identifier are returned.

### Read-Only

- `servers` (Attributes List) The list of servers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers))

<a id="nestedatt--servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers`

Read-Only:

- `cluster` (String) The identifier of the cluster the server is deployed into.
- `hostname` (String) The hostname assigned to the server.
- `id` (String) The unique ID of the server.
- `location_id` (String) The provider location ID of the server.
- `model_id` (String) The provider server model ID.
- `state` (String) The current state of the server.
